# FG-AUTH-0012

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 401 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`oidc-login`](../../ops/runbooks/oidc-login.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `id_token_failures_are_id_token_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ログインを完了できませんでした。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The sign-in could not be completed. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Proses masuk tidak dapat diselesaikan. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

The ID token the identity provider returned at the callback failed verification (ADR-0021 §9): its signature, its algorithm (only `auth.oidc.signing_algs`, RS256 by default, ES256 optional; never `none`, HS* or PS*), its key (`kid` required; the JWKS key must pair kty and alg: RS256 = RSA 2048..8192 bit, ES256 = EC P-256 with 32-byte x / y on the curve), `iss` (equal to the discovery issuer and `auth.oidc.issuer`), `aud` (must contain the client id; with several audiences `azp` must be the client id), `exp` / `iat` / `nbf` (60 s clock skew), `nonce` (the login's) or `sub` (1..255 characters). Nothing was written; the person is not signed in.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.auth.login_failed` carries `reason`: malformed, alg_not_allowed (with `alg`), kid_missing, unknown_kid (also after the JWKS refetch, or within 60 s of the last refetch), key_invalid (with `detail`: base64, rsa_modulus_size, rsa_exponent, ec_coordinate_length, ec_point, crv, kty, use), key_alg_mismatch (with `alg`, `kty`), signature, issuer, audience, azp, expired, not_yet_valid (iat or nbf in the future beyond the skew), nonce, subject, missing_claim (with `claim`). The token itself is never logged. `signature` / `unknown_kid` right after a key rotation at the identity provider are expected for at most 60 s; constant ones point at a wrong `auth.oidc.issuer`, a wrong realm key or a man in the middle.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook oidc-login: compare `auth.oidc.issuer` with the discovery document, check the realm's signing keys and algorithm (RS256), the client id and the server clock (`forge doctor` reports the clock skew to the identity provider). For key_alg_mismatch / key_invalid, fix the realm's key configuration.
